name: Apotris
subtitle: A fast, feature-packed block-stacking game
localizedDescription: Apotris — a fast, feature-packed block-stacking game — running natively on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro through Metal (no emulator). Marathon, Sprint, Ultra, Dig, Blitz, Zen and more, with gesture / GB-button / controller / keyboard input, display filters (Sharp / LCD / CRT), and the full skin and palette customization. Built on Apotris by akouzoukos.
